items.name: Dashboard Status Scan
items.short: Scan Windows, power, VBS/HVCI, adapter and Vanguard.
items.description: Runs a read-only diagnostic pass and fills the dashboard/log with system, app and network state.
items.commandPreview:
Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
Get-NetAdapter | Where Status -eq Up
sc query vgc
winget --version

items.name: Valorant Guard
items.short: Blocks Vanguard-breaking tweaks unless override is explicitly enabled.
items.description: Protects Riot Client, Vanguard service, VALORANT processes and security stack from aggressive guarded actions.
items.commandPreview:
sc query vgc
Confirm-SecureBootUEFI
Get-Tpm
Get-CimInstance Win32_DeviceGuard

items.name: Command Preview
items.short: Show exact commands before running actions.
items.description: Copies/prints the PowerShell and command-line operations for the selected action.

items.name: Minimal Windows Gamer Mode
items.short: Notifications off, GameDVR off, dark mode, mouse acceleration off, cleaner taskbar.
items.description: Applies basic Windows gaming/minimalism changes with backup first.
items.commandPreview:
reg add HKCU\System\GameConfigStore /v GameDVR_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
reg add HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse /v MouseSpeed /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f

items.name: Max Power / CPU
items.short: Ultimate Performance, EPP 0, boost aggressive, PCIe and USB power saving off.
items.description: Applies powercfg CPU and platform power changes for maximum performance.

items.name: BCDEdit / VBS Pack
items.short: Guarded security pack; skipped by Valorant Guard unless override is enabled.
items.description: Applies BCDEdit timer changes and disables hypervisor/VBS/HVCI only when explicitly allowed.
items.commandPreview:
bcdedit /set disabledynamictick yes
bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype off
reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard /v EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

items.name: Network Diagnostics
items.short: Adapter state, TCP state, DNS, gateway ping and jitter sample.
items.description: Exports a network diagnostic report before applying network tweaks.
items.commandPreview:
ipconfig /all
netsh int tcp show global
ping 1.1.1.1 -n 20

items.name: Network Low Latency
items.short: RSS on, RSC/LSO off, interrupt moderation off, NIC power saving off.
items.description: Applies adapter/TCP changes commonly used for latency-focused Windows tuning.
items.commandPreview:
netsh int tcp set global rss=enabled
Disable-NetAdapterRsc -Name <adapter>
Disable-NetAdapterLso -Name <adapter>

items.name: Install App Bundle
items.short: Install/update Brave, Discord, Steam, Spotify, NVCleanstall, Stremio and Prism.
items.description: Uses winget show before winget install/upgrade for exact package IDs.
items.commandPreview:
winget show --id Discord.Discord -e
winget install -e --id Discord.Discord --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements

items.name: Optimize Discord
items.short: Kill Discord/Update, clear cache, backup settings.json, edit startup/hardware if detected.
items.description: Aggressively optimizes Discord while keeping a backup of settings.json.
items.commandPreview:
Stop-Process -Name Discord,Update -Force
Copy-Item settings.json settings.json.bak_dstx
Remove-Item Cache,Code Cache,GPUCache -Recurse -Force

items.name: Optimize Steam
items.short: Disable startup, clear htmlcache/httpcache, handle steamwebhelper safely.
items.description: Cleans Steam web caches but does not kill Steam globally because Steam games can depend on it.
items.commandPreview:
Remove startup Run key
Remove-Item Steam\appcache\httpcache -Recurse -Force
Stop-Process steamwebhelper -Force

items.name: Optimize Brave
items.short: Startup off, cache purge, GPUCache, ShaderCache and gaming shortcut.
items.description: Cleans Brave browser caches and creates a separate gaming shortcut.
items.commandPreview:
Stop-Process brave -Force
Remove-Item Brave Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache, ShaderCache
Create Brave Gaming.lnk

items.name: VALORANT Profile
items.short: Never kill Riot, protect vgc, remove admin compatibility flags if needed.
items.description: A protected per-game profile for VALORANT and Vanguard-sensitive systems.
items.commandPreview:
reg delete AppCompatFlags\Layers /v <valorant.exe> /f
sc config vgc start= demand
net start vgc

items.name: Add Custom EXE Profile
items.short: Choose game executable, add to priority watcher, set fullscreen flags.
items.description: Creates a per-game profile entry and adds its process name to ImportantApps.
items.commandPreview:
OpenFileDialog *.exe
Add process to ImportantApps.txt
Set AppCompatFlags if selected

items.name: Fix Bluetooth
items.short: Restore Bluetooth services and scan devices.
items.description: Repair helper for Bluetooth issues after aggressive debloat or driver instability.
items.commandPreview:
sc config bthserv start= demand
net start bthserv
pnputil /scan-devices

items.name: DISM + SFC Repair
items.short: Windows image and system file repair flow.
items.description: Runs DISM RestoreHealth and SFC scannow.

items.name: Export Report ZIP
items.short: Power plan, TCP state, apps, processes, services and current log.
items.description: Creates a support/diagnostic bundle in ProgramData.
items.commandPreview:
powercfg /getactivescheme
netsh int tcp show global
tasklist /v
Compress-Archive

items.name: Guard Rules
items.short: Configure what Valorant Guard blocks and what requires override.
items.description: Shows guarded actions and controls confirmation behavior.
